EHIGH UWB Positioning

EHIGH, ForThink’s Everhigh brand, brings together ultra-wideband tags, anchors and location software for centimetre-level tracking in suitable deployments.

Discuss your project↘

How it works

Tags and anchors

Tags travel with people, vehicles or assets. Fixed UWB anchors supply position measurements in monitored areas, including indoor environments where satellite coverage is limited.

Hybrid coverage

Combine UWB with Bluetooth Angle of Arrival (AoA) or plan blended UBeacon/iBeacon coverage when zones have different accuracy and installation needs.

Map and location analytics

EmapEng provides 3D GIS visualisation. Etrack supports geofences, route analysis and event alerts. Ecloud provides the location IoT platform and easySDK supports integration.

Deployment considerations

Applications
Site workforce and plant tracking, industrial assets, warehouse and logistics workflows
Accuracy
Centimetre-level positioning in suitable UWB deployments; validate performance in each zone.
Integration
Location platform, maps and API/SDK requirements scoped to the project
